title: 消化氣淨化與利用
summary: 本課以沼氣污染物分離、甲烷回收與淨能源為主線，從乾基氣量與甲烷分率、水分與冷凝、硫化氫吸附床、矽氧烷與設備沉積進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops biogas contaminant separation, methane recovery and net energy through ten connected units, beginning with dry-gas volume and methane fraction, moisture and condensation, hydrogen-sulfide sorbent bed, siloxanes and equipment deposition. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
